verdict.rationale: Whether an email client or service is open source is a fair question for this kind of product, since open-source mail clients exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Outlook's source code is published under an open license. The docs describe only the Microsoft Graph mail APIs, and the community items discuss usability, not source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
